findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
1st REPEAT: Floor tiles are damaged and missing near the ice machine in the back storage room. Repair floor and replace tiles so that the floor is smooth and easily cleanable.
6-501.11: PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be maintained in good repair. [C]

findings.title: Management, food employee and conditional employee; knowledge, responsibilities and reporting
findings.comment: Signed reporting agreements were not available for staff present. Documents were provided, and employee health policy was discussed. Owner and food service manager signed reporting agreements during inspection. Ensure all staff are educated on the employee health policy upon hiring and sign reporting agreements prior to beginning their first shift. Maintain signed copies of reporting agreements for staff.
findings.citation_text: 2-103.11 (O) The person in charge shall ensure that food employees are informed in a verifiable manner of their responsibility to report in accordance with law, to the person in charge, information about their health and activities as they relate to diseases that are transmissible through food, as specified under  2-201.11(A). [Pf]

findings.title: Procedures for responding to vomiting and diarrheal events
findings.comment: Norovirus disinfection policy provided during pre-opening could not be located. A new copy of disinfection policy was provided. Maintain a copy of the disinfection policy on-site.
findings.citation_text: 2-501.11 A food establishment shall have written procedures for employees to follow when responding to vomiting or diarrheal events that involve the discharge of vomitus or fecal matter onto surfaces in the food establishment. The procedures shall address the specific actions employees must take to minimize the spread of contamination and the exposure of employees, consumers, food, and surfaces to vomitus or fecal matter. [Pf]

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible
findings.comment:
No paper towels are available in the mens restroom. CORRECTED- Paper towels were provided. Ensure paper towels are always available at all handwashing sinks.
6-301.12: Each HANDWASHING SINK shall be provided with: (A) Individual, disposable towels; (B) A continuous towel system that supplies the user with a clean towel; (C) A heated-air hand drying device; (D) A hand drying device that employs an air-knife system that delivers high velocity, pressurized air at ambient temperatures. [Pf]

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible
findings.comment:
Empty can observed in the basin of the handwashing sink. CORRECTED- Items were removed from the sink basin. Ensure handwashing sinks are always clear and accessible to promote frequent handwashing.
5-205.11: (A) A HANDWASHING SINK shall be maintained so that it is accessible at all times for EMPLOYEE use. (B) A HANDWASHING SINK may not be used for purposes other than handwashing. (C) An automatic handwashing facility shall be used in accordance with manufacturer’s instructions. [C]

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment:
Brown mold accumulation observed on the baffle of the ice machine. Clean and sanitize ice machine baffle.
4-601.11: (A) EQUIPMENT FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES and UTENSILS shall be clean to sight and touch. [Pf]

findings.title: Proper date marking and disposition
findings.comment:
Gallons of milk in the customer reach-in cooler observed past their manufacturer date-markings. Two were labeled use by 11/7, and another three were labeled use by 11/29. CORRECTED- Out of date milk was voluntarily discarded.
3-501.18: (A) FOOD shall be discarded if exceeding temperature and time criteria. If container or PACKAGE does not bear a date or day or if inappropriately marked with date or day exceeding temperature and time combination. (B) Refrigerated RTE TCS FOOD prepared in FOOD ESTABLISHMENT and dispensed through vending machine shall be discarded if exceeding temperature and time. [P]

findings.title: Garbage & refuse properly disposed; facilities maintained
findings.comment: Garbage can was not present within the vicinity of the food service area handwashing sink. Provide a small waste receptacle for disposal of paper towels at the handwashing sink.
findings.citation_text: 5-501.16 If disposable towels are used at handwashing lavatories, a waste receptacle shall be located at each lavatory or group of adjacent lavatories. [C]

findings.title: Management, food employee and conditional employee; knowledge, responsibilities and reporting
findings.citation_text:
2-103.11 (O) Employee health documents provided during pre-opening could not be located, and signed reporting agreements were not available for the owner and food service manager. Documents were provided, and employee health policy was discussed. Owner and food service manager signed reporting agreements during inspection. Ensure all staff are educated on the employee health policy upon hiring and sign reporting agreements prior to beginning their first shift. Maintain signed copies of reporting agreements for staff.
The person in charge shall ensure that food employees are informed in a verifiable manner of their responsibility to report in accordance with law, to the person in charge, information about their health and activities as they relate to diseases that are transmissible through food, as specified under  2-201.11(A).

findings.title: Procedures for responding to vomiting and diarrheal events
findings.citation_text:
2-501.11 Norovirus disinfection policy provided during pre-opening could not be located. A new copy of disinfection policy was provided. Maintain a copy of the disinfection policy on-site.
A food establishment shall have written procedures for employees to follow when responding to vomiting or diarrheal events that involve the discharge of vomitus or fecal matter onto surfaces in the food establishment. The procedures shall address the specific actions employees must take to minimize the spread of contamination and the exposure of employees, consumers, food, and surfaces to vomitus or fecal matter.

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible
findings.citation_text:
6-301.14 Handwashing sign is not posted at the handwashing sink in the food service area. Handwashing signs were provided and posted during inspection.
A sign or poster that notifies food employees to wash their hands shall be provided at all handwashing sinks used by food employees and shall be clearly visible to food employees.

findings.title: Food separated and protected
findings.citation_text:
3-302.11 Raw shell eggs (personal use) were stored above onions, jar of banana peppers, and cans of olives and mushrooms in the bottom of the pizza prep cooler. Carton was moved to the bottom of the cooler. Ensure proper storage of raw animal products below and separate from ready to eat foods.
Food shall be protected from cross contamination during storage, preparation, holding, and display by separating raw animal foods from ready to eat foods.

findings.title: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used
findings.citation_text:
7-102.11 Chemical spray bottle in the restroom was not labeled. Owner verified it contained Awesome cleaner, and the bottle was labeled as to the contents.
Working containers used for storing poisonous or toxic materials such as cleaners and sanitizers taken from bulk supplies and/or prepared on-site shall be clearly and individually identified with the common name of the material.

findings.title: Thermometers provided & accurate
findings.citation_text: 4-302.12 Food thermometer was not available for use. Provide a food thermometer. Food temperature measuring devices shall be provided and readily accessible for use in ensuring attainment and maintenance of food temperatures.

findings.title: Toilet facilities: properly constructed, supplied, & cleaned
findings.citation_text:
6-501.18 1. Handwashing sink and toilet were soiled with general buildup in the restroom.
2. Handwashing sink in the food service area was soiled with general buildup. 
Clean plumbing fixtures daily/as needed and maintain them clean.
Plumbing fixtures such as handwashing sinks, toilets, and urinals shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean.

findings.title: Garbage & refuse properly disposed; facilities maintained
findings.citation_text:

If disposable towels are used at handwashing lavatories, a waste receptacle shall be located at each lavatory or group of adjacent lavatories.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment: No sanitizing agent is available.

findings.title: Warewashing facilities: installed, maintained, & used; test strips
findings.comment: 4-302.14: No test kit is available for the facility.   A test kit or other device that accurately measures the concentration in MG/L of SANITIZING solutions shall be provided.

findings.title: Charge present, demonstrates knowledge, and performs duties
findings.comment: 2-102.11: Owner was completely unaware of any of the basics of safe food handling. No knowledge on operations, sanitizers, hand washing, washing, no knowledge of temperatures. No knowledge of basics. Based on the RISKS inherent to the FOOD operation, PIC shall demonstrate knowledge by:  (A) Having no Priority Foundation items; (B) Being a CFM; OR (C) Responding correctly questions as they relate to the specific FOOD operation. The areas of knowledge include C1 through C16.

findings.title: Certified Food Protection Manager (CFPM)
findings.comment: 2-102.12: No CFPM is present.  (A) The PERSON IN CHARGE shall be a certified FOOD protection manager who has shown proficiency of required information through passing a test that is part of an ACCREDITED PROGRAM.

findings.title: Sewage and waste water properly disposed
findings.comment: 5-402.12: There is no grease trap present at the facility. Referred to City.  If used, a grease trap shall be located to be easily accessible for cleaning, operation and maintenance.

findings.title: No bare hand contact with RTE food or a pre-approved alternative procedure properly allowed
findings.comment: 3-301.11: The facility is not washing hands during food preparation. Pizza was cut and placed in hot holding without proper handwashing.  (A) FOOD EMPLOYEES shall properly wash hands (C). (B) FOOD EMPLOYEES shall not contact RTE FOODS with bare hands – except washing fruits and veggies (P). (C) FOOD EMPLOYEES shall minimize contact with FOOD that is not RTE (Pf). (D) Contact does not apply to RTE Food being added as ingredient to be cooked. (E) FOOD EMPLOYEES not serving a HSP may contact exposed, RTE with bare hands if approved.

findings.title: Food obtained from approved source
findings.comment: 3-201.11: The facility is permitted as a Class III facility and is observed serving pizza.  (A)-(B) FOOD shall be obtained from APPROVED source and not from private home. P (C) PACKAGED Food shall be properly labeled. (E) WHOLE-MUSCLE BEEF shall be from approved source and acceptable from AUTHROITY. Pf (D) FISH must be frozen if consumed undercooked. (F) Meat and Poultry shall be properly labeled. (G) Eggs shall be properly labeled. C

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible
findings.comment: 5-204.11: The kitchen has no hand sink. A HANDWASHING SINK shall be located: (A) To allow convenient use by EMPLOYEES in FOOD preparation, FOOD dispensing, and WAREWASHING areas (B) In, or immediately adjacent to, toilet rooms.

findings.title: Gloves used properly
findings.comment: Gloves used improperly - gloves are observed used and then laid on the counter for available future use.

findings.title: Proper hot holding temperatures
findings.comment: Hot holding temperature of available pizza hot holding unit is 100F. Pizza discarded during the inspection.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.citation_text:
6-501.11 Ceiling tiles in restroom have evidence of water damage and are acoustic. Replace the ceiling tiles in the restroom with smooth, cleanable tiles. 
-Floors were in disrepair in the following areas:
1. in the restroom - damage in front of the door by the threshold; 
2. in front of the tobacco case - damaged tiles with exposed subfloor; and
3. in front of and under the ice machine - damaged tiles with exposed subfloor and warped tiles from moisture.
Provide proper repairs to flooring throughout the facility so it is smooth and easily cleanable. 
Physical facilities shall be maintained in good repair.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.citation_text:
6-501.16 Damp mop was stored in the mop bucket. Store mop so it dries properly between uses. 
After use, mops shall be placed in a position that allows them to air-dry without soiling walls, equipment, or supplies.

findings.title: Adequate ventilation and lighting; designated areas used
findings.citation_text:
6-303.11 Light in the restroom was out. Owner stated he had extra light bulbs somewhere. Provide a working light bulb in the restroom.
Light intensity shall be at least 20 foot candles (215 lux) in restrooms.

findings.title: Charge present, demonstrates knowledge, and performs duties
findings.citation_text:
2-102.11 (A), (B) & (C)(1), (4)-(16) Multiple priority violations were observed during the inspection today. Owner was not present at the time of inspection. Follow-up inspection will be conducted in 10 days to discuss violations and plans for permanent corrective actions.
Based on the risks inherent to the food operation, during inspections and upon request the PIC shall demonstrate to the regulatory authority knowledge of foodborne disease prevention, application of the hazard analysis and critical control points, and the requirements of the Code.

findings.title: Hands clean and properly washed
findings.citation_text:
2-301.14 Ice was packaged on-site to sell for the purpose of consumption. Adequate facilities are not currently present to allow for this practice (see #10), and hands could not have been properly washed prior to packaging ice due to the lack of a handwashing sink in the dispensing area. Cease the practice of packaging ice on-site until adequate facilities are available.
Food Employees shall clean their hands and exposed portions of their arms immediately before engaging in food preparation including working with exposed food, clean equipment and utensils, and unwrapped single-service and single-use articles, prior to putting on gloves, and after engaging in other activities that contaminate the hands.

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible
findings.citation_text:
5-204.11 Facility is not adequately equipped with a handwashing sink in the back of the facility where ice machine is located. A handwashing sink must be provided if owner wishes to sell ice packaged on-site. Cease the practice of selling cups of ice until adequate facilities are available for handwashing in the dispensing area.
A handwashing sink shall be located to allow convenient use by employees in food preparation, food dispensing, and warewashing areas.

findings.title: Food obtained from approved source
findings.citation_text:
3-201.11 Styrofoam cups with ice were observed in a small freezer available for purchase. Proper facilities are not currently present to allow for retail sale of ice for consumption. All cups of ice were removed from the freezer and discarded in the dumpster outside with other trash. Cease the practice of packaging ice on-site for the purposes of consumption. 
This violation was corrected immediately, but a follow-up inspection will be conducted in 10 days to discuss the situation with the owner due to the fact that this is a repeat violation that was also observed during the routine inspection in 2018. 
Food shall be obtained from sources that comply with law.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.citation_text:
4-602.11 Ice scoop is unable to be properly cleaned due to lack of adequate facilities (see #48). Cease the practice of using the ice scoop for packaging ice to be sold for the purposes of consumption. Based on the available facilities, the ice scoop may only be used for scooping ice into containers that will be used to chill bottled and canned beverages. Any other use is prohibited. 
Surfaces of utensils and equipment contacting food that is not time/temperature control for safety food (TCS) shall be cleaned at any time when contamination may have occurred. 

Pink mold accumulation was observed on the lower edge of the metal baffle inside the ice machine. Discoloration (possibly rust) was also observed on the ceiling inside the ice machine. Clean the ice machine as needed, and maintain it clean. 
Equipment such as ice bins and enclosed compartments such as ice makers shall be cleaned at a frequency specified by the manufacturer, or absent manufacturer specifications, at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil or mold.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.citation_text:
4-702.11 Ice scoop is unable to be properly sanitized due to the lack of adequate facilities (see #48). Cease the practice of using the ice scoop for packaging ice to be sold for the purposes of consumption. Based on the available facilities, the ice scoop may only be used for scooping ice into containers that will be used to chill bottled and canned beverages. Any other use is prohibited. 
Utensils and food contact surfaces shall be sanitized before use after cleaning.

findings.title: Thermometers provided & accurate
findings.citation_text:
4-204.112 Thermometer was not present in the small freezer holding Hot Pockets and White Castle burgers. Provide a thermometer, and ensure functioning thermometers are available in all cold holding units used for the storage of TCS foods.
Cold holding equipment used for TCS food shall be designed to include and shall be equipped with at least one permanently affixed temperature measuring device that is located to allow easy viewing of the device's temperature display.

findings.title: Warewashing facilities: installed, maintained, & used; test strips
findings.citation_text:
4-301.12 Facility is not adequately equipped with a 3 compartment sink to allow for manual wash, rinse, and sanitize of ice scoop. A 3 part sink with compartments large enough for submersion of equipment and utensils must be provided if owner wishes to sell ice packaged on-site. Cease the practice of selling cups of ice until adequate facilities are available for manual ware washing. 
A sink with at least 3 compartments shall be provided for manually washing, rinsing, and sanitizing equipment and utensils. Sink compartments shall be large enough to accommodate immersion of the largest equipment and utensils.
